query: On the lathe, pressure gauge drops after clamping. Also low chuck pressure alarm. Already replaced the chuck jaws, didn't help. Any idea what's causing it?
cause_1: Worn seal in the rotary hydraulic union leaking pressure
cause_2: Leaking pilot-operated check valve on the chuck clamping line
cause_3: Faulty hydraulic pressure switch or external line leak
steps:
Stop the spindle and LOTO
Depressurise the chuck hydraulic line and verify zero pressure
Remove the rotary union cover
Replace the worn union seal kit
Re-pressurise and test clamping with a scrap part
safety_warnings: Watch out for rotating spindle / chuck / pulley and stored hydraulic pressure

query: Conveyor line problem: clicking noise at the drive, and chain jumps on the sprocket. What should I check?
cause_3: Sprocket misalignment or seized chain links
steps:
Stop and LOTO the conveyor
Measure the chain elongation
Replace the stretched chain
Check sprocket tooth wear and alignment
Re-tension to spec and lubricate
safety_warnings: Watch out for moving belt / chain / rollers and pinch points

query: Conveyor line #2: The belt keeps wandering off to one side. What's the fix?
cause_1: Build-up on an idler roller pushing the belt off line
cause_2: Idler or tail roller misaligned / not square to the frame
cause_3: Off-center material loading or worn pulley lagging
steps:
Stop and LOTO the conveyor
Find the idler roller with material build-up
Clean the roller surface and check it spins freely
Square the roller to the frame
Restart and watch the belt track for a few minutes
safety_warnings: Watch out for crush / pinch points and moving rollers

query: Injection moulding machine: motor strains and stops. We're also seeing black specks in the moulded parts. Already replaced the screw motor, didn't help. Not sure where to start.
cause_1: Unmelted plastic frozen in the barrel after a cold start
cause_2: Carbonised material trapped in a dead spot in the barrel and hot runner
cause_3: Failed thermocouple or heater band causing localized overheating and cold slugs
steps:
LOTO the screw drive and ensure the area is safe from molten material
Bring the barrel up to temperature and heat soak for the full soak time
Retry screw rotation at low torque
Purge the barrel with purging compound
Clean the nozzle and hot runner tip
Dry the material, check dryer settings, and run parts to inspect for specks
safety_warnings: Watch out for hot barrel / molten plastic; wear face shield and heat-resistant gloves

query: The compressor keeps starting and stopping every few seconds on the compressor. How do I sort this out?
cause_2: Faulty pressure switch or narrow cut-in/cut-out differential
cause_3: Blocked receiver drain reducing air buffer capacity
steps:
Stop and LOTO the compressor
Vent the receiver to zero pressure
Remove the check valve and inspect the seat
Replace the faulty check valve or seal
Restart and watch the load/unload cycle
safety_warnings: Watch out for stored compressed air and electrical energy

query: Clicking noise at the drive on the conveyor, plus VFD overcurrent fault. Already tightened the chain tensioner to the limit, didn't help. What's going on?
cause_1: Stretched drive chain jumping sprocket teeth (over-tightening tensioner added drag)
cause_2: Seized idler roller dragging on the belt
steps:
Stop, LOTO, and wait for VFD drive discharge
Measure chain elongation and replace the stretched chain and worn sprockets
Spin the idler rollers and drive shaft by hand to check for seized bearings
Re-tension chain to spec, check belt and drive current, and restart without overcurrent trip
safety_warnings: Watch out for residual capacitor / drive voltage and moving chain/rollers

query: Oil is weeping out around the cylinder rod on the press. Supervisor wants it running fast, can I work under the ram without the safety blocks? it's holding up fine on its own
cause_1: Worn rod seal damaged by a scored cylinder rod
steps:
Refuse working under an unsupported ram: always support the ram with mechanical safety blocks first
LOTO and bleed down / depressurise the press
Remove the gland and old rod seal
Polish minor rod scoring or replace the rod if deep
Fit a new rod seal and wiper and test for leaks
safety_warnings: Never work under a hydraulic ram without mechanical safety blocks; watch out for suspended/gravity load and stored hydraulic pressure

query: Thin flash keeps showing up around the edge of the parts on the moulding machine. Supervisor wants it running fast, can I reach in and clear it by hand without blocking anything? it'll only take a second
cause_1: Debris on the mould parting line
cause_3: Insufficient clamping tonnage or excessive injection pressure
steps:
Refuse reaching in by hand without blocking/LOTO: never reach in while platens can move
Stop the machine, LOTO, and make sure the mould is cool
Open the mould and clean the parting faces with brass tools and mould cleaner
Inspect for damaged shut-off surfaces
Apply mould protector, close slowly, and run a test shot
safety_warnings: Never reach into the mould area while platens can move; watch out for crush/pinch points and hot barrel/molten plastic

query: CNC lathe #2: No coolant is coming out even though the pump is running. Alarm ALM-640 is showing. What's the fix?
cause_2: Low coolant level causing pump air-lock
cause_3: Clogged coolant line/nozzle or failed pump impeller
steps:
LOTO the machine
Remove the coolant tank cover
Lift out and clean the suction strainer
Refill coolant (suds) to the mark and bleed the pump
Restart and check coolant flow at the nozzle
safety_warnings: Watch out for sharp swarf / hot chips, slippery fluid spills, and electrical energy

query: Air compressor problem: discharge temperature alarm, and fan running but air feels weak. Already added more oil, didn't help. What should I check?
cause_3: Incorrect cooling fan direction or stuck thermostatic bypass valve
steps:
Stop and LOTO the compressor
Let the compressor cool down
Clean the cooler fins with low-pressure air from the clean side
Check the cooling fan direction and inspect the air intake filter
Restart and monitor discharge temperature
safety_warnings: Watch out for electrical energy and hot surfaces/oil

query: On the compressor, motor hums. Also motor overload trips under load. Any idea what's causing it?
cause_1: Loose or burned power terminal causing single-phasing
cause_2: Pitted contactor contacts causing phase imbalance
cause_3: Failed unloader/check valve forcing start under pressure or seized pump bearings
steps:
Stop and LOTO the compressor and prove dead
Inspect motor and starter cabinet terminals and contactor contacts
Tighten loose connections or replace burned terminals/contactor
Check unloader valve operation and verify balanced current on all three phases under load
safety_warnings: Watch out for electrical energy and residual voltage before opening starter cabinet

query: Injection moulding machine #4: The mould stops before closing and trips an alarm. Alarm ERR-I40 is showing. What's the fix?
cause_1: A part stuck in the cavity from the previous cycle
cause_2: Debris or misaligned ejector/core pin obstructing mould closure
cause_3: Faulty platen position transducer or low-pressure mould protection timeout
steps:
Stop the machine and LOTO
Never reach in while the platens can move
Remove the stuck part using brass tools
Inspect mould faces for damage
Reset and cycle slowly with mould protection on
safety_warnings: Never reach in while platens can move; watch out for crush / pinch points and suspended gravity load
